walkforward.split: first half development / second half confirmation

models: ensemble_eq (equal-weight ranks of freq_all, ewma_0.9, trend_20v20, pair_last; no tuning)
gate: A method is validated iff Holm-adjusted full-sample one-sided p<0.05 AND development p<0.05 AND confirmation p<0.05

typesafe.calls: exactly one system_one request containing all questions; no retries after a completed valid response

final_decision_rule_declared_before_jev.validated_edge_branch: If the gate passed for any method: final ticket = candidate generated by the gated method with the lowest Holm p (ties: highest Jev Choice probability). Jev cannot override.
final_decision_rule_declared_before_jev.no_edge_branch: If no method passed the gate (all candidates have equal expected value 36/38 under the validated evidence): final ticket = the candidate with the highest probability in the Jev Choice distribution from the FIRST valid completed Jev response. Score/Noul answers are recorded as advisory diagnostics only and do not change the choice. Ties broken by lower candidate ID.
final_decision_rule_declared_before_jev.jev_unavailable_fallback: If no valid Jev response can be obtained before 2026-09-24T00:30Z: final ticket = candidates[int(sha256(candidate_evidence.json), 16) % n], labelled Claude-only fallback.
